_readme: Declarative map of migration name -> a boolean SQL predicate that proves the
migration's effect is already present in the database. Consumed by
src/schema/reconcile-ledger.cjs, which NEVER stamps blindly: a name missing
from hospital.pgmigrations is only stamped when its evidence query returns
true. A migration file with no entry here is reported as UNKNOWN and makes
the script exit non-zero — that is how this manifest stays current as new
Every predicate must be a single SELECT returning exactly one boolean.
over row counts; use a row probe only for pure data migrations.

entries.name: 000_genesis
entries.evidence: SELECT to_regclass('hospital.ipd_doc') IS NOT NULL AND to_regprocedure('hospital.update_modified_column()') IS NOT NULL
entries.note: Genesis objects. 001 ALTERs ipd_doc and attaches a trigger that calls update_modified_column(), so 001 being applied implies both exist.
